result: Pass for evidence, identity, counting and planned integration; minor public-text spacing cleanup remains.
auditScope: Bounded read-only packet/configuration review. History and language supplement were authored by this reviewer; final checks there verify their actual selected evidence and integration, rather than claim a second independent authorship review. Museum and community fit were independently checked against existing exact source URLs. No new source discovery, Site edits, contacts or delegation.

counts.explanation: Talimali self-account collection 1 + PBS transcript 1 + museum collection 1 + Hann book 1 + McEwan technical nomination 1. Short projects page is false. The language supplement adds a section to Hann, not a card/work.

identityAndEvidenceFindings.finding: Talimali Today and What We Do actually state educational/research purposes, 1995 nonprofit organization and 1996 recognition filing. Proposed paragraph explicitly attributes those institutional statements. No independent incorporation, eligibility, lineage, exclusivity or recognition outcome is inferred.

Projects remains supporting. Dated 2021 relief reporting and undated plans are distinguished from completion or current availability. This review read the packet and independent peer audit; it did not freshly reread the projects page.

Fresh actual PBS transcript spot-check confirms Episode 7/2006 imprint and direct Bennett/Zuberi exchanges on PDF 1 and 4. Descendant participation is not overstated as formal partnership or genealogical proof. No video viewed. Artifact-origin, religious and burial interpretations are excluded.

Freshly reread all five exact museum bodies. The proposed paragraph matches requests/diplomacy, Spanish authority, coerced labor, attacks, the 1704 end, displacement, timeline's later Louisiana route, material/written evidence and modern reconstruction. Five related institutional pages count conservatively once.

Selected political evidence supports qualified village autonomy and prominence without command over other major villages. Actual printed 118 supports the short letter/translation caution. The original letter was not independently inspected or translated; no current vitality or sole-surviving-text claim. Old extinction framing is excluded.

Actual saved nomination PDF 21 freshly rechecked: prepared January 7, 2003, and separately marks additional documentation added in 2004. Method and local political-architecture claims match recorded selections. A technical nomination does not establish contemporary tribal recognition, universal voluntary conversion or all-Apalachee conditions.

museumSpecificLimits: The Apalachee page's sweeping archaeological origin chronology, absence-of-writing assumptions, gender/clan generalizations and exact demographic figures are not in the proposed synthesis.

End of the Mission System uses a fading-away formulation and colonial Mobile/Louisiana terminology. The packet explicitly excludes disappearance claims and uses the timeline to distinguish subsequent movement to the Red River; no modern-state error is introduced.

The museum's European grid description differs from the older nomination's discussion of changing house orientations and absence of a formal grid. Neither grid claim appears in the integrated synthesis, so this disagreement produces no present contradiction.
The timeline ends in October 2022; its date and the 2026 footer are not assigned as page publication dates. Its 1996 contact entry is not treated as discovery or beginning of the people.
The short archaeology page supports a public explanation of evidence. It is neither a separately counted excavation report nor authority to exclude community knowledge.

wordBudget.method: Whitespace count after basic fused letter/number normalization. Counts annotation, complete displayed review scope, inspected-subresource scope text, every supplied cited section and relevant overview. Final column additionally includes the source-specific public evidence note, since build.mjs displays evidenceNotes. Bibliographic titles, Atlas-owned count/provenance metadata and unrendered rights notes are excluded.
wordBudget.caution: Hann reaches exactly 200 when its source-specific public note is included. Do not append another Hann-derived sentence, overview citation or visible rights-note summary without shortening and recalculating. PBS and Hann packet rights notes are not rendered by current sourceCard; adding them to visible text would require another budget check.
